PostgreSQL cannot ALTER an existing table to add partitioning in-place; you must create a new partitioned table. The approach: rename the old table, CREATE TABLE events (PARTITION BY RANGE ...), create child partitions, then copy the data back.

Declare the parent: CREATE TABLE events (..., created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL) PARTITION BY RANGE (created_at); then for each month: CREATE TABLE events_2024_01 PARTITION OF events FOR VALUES FROM ('2024-01-01') TO ('2024-02-01');
After creating at least two monthly partitions (e.g., 2024-01 and 2024-02) copy the rows from the old table: INSERT INTO events SELECT * FROM events_old;
